learnerSourceCheck.prompt: On a zero-to-one number line with two equal intervals, what fraction is the single interior tick?

supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s learn about fractions on the number line.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Extend understanding of whole numbers on the number line to see fractions on a number line.
teachingSteps: Choose the whole interval from zero to one.
Partition it into equal intervals according to the denominator.
Count intervals from zero to locate and name the numerator position.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Intervals must be equal; tick count is not the same as interval count from zero.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.targetRichV2Field: lesson-specific correction proposal; not the published canonical body

firstPartyPractice.prompt: Partition 0–1 into fourths. What fraction is the third mark after zero?

independentEdulyticsCoolDown.prompt: Partition 0–1 into six equal intervals. What fraction is at the fifth mark?

stageC.humanRubric: Student must locate positions on correctly partitioned number lines, not assign labels to intervals.
